items.quote: Bitte begleichen Sie den Rechnungsbetrag innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum unter Angabe der Rechnungsnummer.
items.computation: Private payment obligation, counted under §§ 187, 193 BGB. Period start: Rechnungsdatum 26.06.2026 (Friday); this day is not counted (§187 Abs.1 BGB). 30 days later (calendar days) = 26.07.2026 (Sunday). Since the last day falls on a Sunday, the deadline moves to the next working day (§193 BGB) = Monday 27.07.2026. The payer's address on the letter is in Hamburg, and no public holiday falls on 27.07.2026 in any German Land, so the shift is unaffected by regional holidays.
